item.title: Seeing Light, Episode One: Quality
item.description:
Alex and Jordan explain light quality, apparent source size, hard and soft light, shadow edges, contrast ratio, and why dawn mist helps white plumage, using Matthew's misty wood storks frames.

item.title: Seeing Light, Episode Two: Direction
item.description:
Alex and Jordan explain front light, side light, and backlight, plus rim light, silhouettes, spot metering, and exposure compensation for dawn wildlife photography.

item.title: Seeing Light, Episode Three: Composition and Light Placement
item.description:
Alex and Jordan explain composition as light placement, including pools of light, background brightness, subject separation, tonal layers, light lines, and shadow negative space.

item.title: Seeing Light, Episode Four: Color Science
item.description:
Alex and Jordan explain color science for wildlife photography, including white balance as a creative choice, Kelvin through the day, mixed light, camera profiles, and saturation versus luminance.

item.title: Seeing Light, Episode Five: When Black and White
item.description:
